motions.stand: Facing left, small antennae tap and front feet flex, head lifts the blunt horn slightly then lowers while cracked mineral shell remains heavy, return to original low stance.
motions.move: Facing left, six sturdy legs alternate tripod groups in an in-place march, feet lift and plant visibly and rust-orange underside shows between steps, blunt horn remains pointed left.

motions.die1: Facing left, six legs fold inward and heavy plated beetle rolls onto its side exposing a little rust-orange underside, antennae sag, finish motionless with mineral plates intact.
